quality_reasons.text: Responsive, friendly rep with good discovery who initially explained correctly that BAAs are only signed on Enterprise
Then told the prospect she is 'covered' for HIPAA on Starter and can put patient details in invoice notes - misleading compliance claim

flags.text: Rep told a healthcare prospect she is 'covered' for HIPAA on the Starter plan and can put patient details in invoice notes, although he had just said BAAs are only signed on Enterprise and Starter has no BAA - misleading compliance claim
flags.evidence: You're totally fine to put patient details in the invoice notes, people do it all the time.
paraphrases: Misleading sales claim: said Starter is fine for HIPAA patient data even though no BAA is offered on that plan.
Rep encouraged storing PHI in invoice notes on a plan without a business associate agreement.
Contradictory compliance information: BAA only on Enterprise, but prospect told she is covered on Starter.
negatives: Rep offered the standard twenty percent annual prepay discount.

decoys.why_not: It is the standard published annual-prepay discount ('that's on the pricing page, everyone gets that').
decoys.evidence: our standard twenty percent annual discount, that's on the pricing page, everyone gets that
paraphrases: Unauthorized 20% discount offered to close the deal.
Rep promised twenty percent off without approval.

acceptable_flags.text: Rep pushed the cheapest plan / did not explore Enterprise pricing
